description: Implement Strava OAuth2 integration (connect/disconnect), fetch and display user activities, and build the fitness challenges system with auto-verification and QR code generation/scanning.
steps: Create src/app/api/strava/connect/route.ts - GET endpoint that redirects to Strava OAuth authorization URL. Scopes: read,activity:read_all. Redirect URI: {NEXTAUTH_URL}/api/strava/callback. Include state parameter for CSRF protection.

Create src/app/api/strava/callback/route.ts - GET endpoint. Exchanges authorization code for access token via Strava API. Stores access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, and athlete.id in user record. Redirects to /dashboard with success message.

Create src/app/api/strava/activities/route.ts - GET endpoint. Uses stored access token to fetch recent activities from Strava API (GET https://www.strava.com/api/v3/athlete/activities). Returns list of activities with: name, type, distance (in km), duration, date. Handle token refresh if expired.

Create src/app/dashboard/strava/page.tsx - Strava page showing: Connect button (if not connected), connection status, list of recent activities in a nice table/card format (activity name, type icon, distance in km, duration formatted, date).

Create src/app/dashboard/challenges/page.tsx - Challenges page. Shows list of active challenges with progress bars. Each challenge shows: title, target distance, current progress (from Strava activities), status (in progress/completed). If completed, shows 'Claim Verification' button.

Create src/app/api/challenges/route.ts - GET returns all challenges. POST creates a new challenge (admin). Challenge shape: {id, title, description, targetDistanceKm, activityType, startDate, endDate, createdBy}.

Create src/app/api/challenges/[id]/verify/route.ts - POST endpoint. Checks if user's Strava activities within the challenge date range meet the target distance. If yes, creates a verification record: {id, uniqueToken (uuid), challengeId, userId, completedAt, distanceAchieved, status: 'verified'}. Generates nothing - the QR code is generated client-side from the token.

Create src/app/api/challenges/[id]/progress/route.ts - GET endpoint. Calculates total distance from user's Strava activities that match the challenge activity type and date range. Returns {totalDistance, targetDistance, percentage, isComplete}.

Create src/app/dashboard/challenges/create/page.tsx - Form to create a new challenge: title, description, target distance (km), activity type (run/ride/walk), start date, end date. POST to /api/challenges.
Create src/app/api/verifications/route.ts - GET endpoint returns all verifications for the current user. Each includes the unique token for QR code generation.

Create src/app/dashboard/verifications/page.tsx - Page showing all earned verifications as QR code cards. Each card shows: challenge title, completion date, distance achieved, and a QR code image. QR code encodes URL: {NEXTAUTH_URL}/verify/{token}. Use the 'qrcode' package to generate QR as data URL.

Create src/app/verify/[token]/page.tsx - Public verification page (no auth required). Fetches verification status from /api/verify/[token]. If valid and verified: show large GREEN background with checkmark icon, challenge name, user name, completion date. If invalid: show RED background with X icon and 'Invalid or expired verification' message.

Create src/app/api/verify/[token]/route.ts - GET endpoint. Looks up verification by token. Returns verification details if found (challenge title, user name, completion date, status). Returns 404 if not found.
Run npm run build to verify everything compiles
acceptance_criteria: Strava dashboard page at /dashboard/strava displays connection UI
Challenges page at /dashboard/challenges shows challenges with progress
Verification page at /verify/[token] shows green (valid) or red (invalid) status
QR codes are generated on the verifications page
API endpoints: GET/POST /api/challenges, POST /api/challenges/[id]/verify, GET /api/challenges/[id]/progress, GET /api/verifications, GET /api/verify/[token]
findings: Build succeeds with all 14 new files. All routes registered: 7 API routes (strava connect/callback/activities, challenges CRUD, challenges progress, challenges verify, verifications, verify token) and 5 pages (strava, challenges, challenges/create, verifications, verify/[token]). Used Suspense boundary for useSearchParams in Strava page (same pattern as FEAT-002). Next.js 16 dynamic route params require Promise-based destructuring (params: Promise<{id: string}>). QR codes generated client-side using dynamic import of 'qrcode' package.
